mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals economic weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly rising housing starts and industrial production indicate strong economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through increased corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO rise, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% and increasing for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenues improve.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising RSAFS, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1300 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where HOUST falls below 1300, or the Rank IC over 1-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS rising) combined with stable or falling interest rates (FEDFUNDS) signals a robust labor market and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market strength with monetary ease
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS rises and FEDFUNDS is stable or falling, or the interaction term in a regression model is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A supply shock indicated by industrial production falling below 100 (INDPRO < 100) leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate output and potential inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.
